notes.zh: Note 富文本编辑新增剪切按钮与 Command + X 快捷键，保留所选文字的格式。
notes.en: Added a Cut button and Command + X shortcut to Note rich-text editors, preserving the selected text’s formatting.

notes.zh: 格式工具栏的所有按钮与折叠按钮统一显示在同一行，操作更集中。
notes.en: All formatting controls, including the collapse button, now appear on a single row.

notes.zh: 剪切支持撤销；无选中文本或剪贴板写入失败时不会删除内容。
notes.en: Cut supports Undo and leaves content intact when no text is selected or the clipboard write fails.
